exposure: pregnancy type (singleton, dichorionic twin, monochorionic twin)
cohort: The study included individuals with singleton or twin pregnancies who received at least two doses of an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine before delivery.
finding: Maternal and cord anti-Spike antibody concentrations were significantly lower in twin pregnancies compared to singleton pregnancies, and antibody transfer efficiency was less efficient in monochorionic compared to dichorionic pregnancies.
